subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface for this issue be read-only pending/list JSON output only, or should it also include resolve/respond and watch behavior from the active related PR?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing pending command text and especially submitting approval decisions from CLI changes an operator security surface that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship List/JSON First
options.body: Expose a read-only `openclaw approvals pending`/`list` command through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC, then handle watch and resolve in separate follow-up review.

options.title: Adopt Broader CLI Control
options.body: Use the active PR direction and require security/proof coverage for both listing and resolving pending approvals before merge.

options.title: Defer CLI Exposure
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in current UI/MCP/backend paths until maintainers decide the CLI contract is worth the security surface.

recommendation.title: Ship List/JSON First
recommendation.body: Expose a read-only `openclaw approvals pending`/`list` command through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC, then handle watch and resolve in separate follow-up review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the approvals CLI/docs surface and already provided concrete scoping guidance on this issue.
